title: ARDS with strong demand on low-flow VC: flow starvation
summary: Square flow 40 L/min against a 12 cmH2O effort. The patient pulls harder than the ventilator delivers: the Paw ramp is scooped (concave), sometimes down to PEEP, and the displayed compliance looks falsely good.
objectives: Recognize the scooped Paw ramp of flow starvation and the effort behind it in the truth layer.
Fix by letting flow follow demand (pressure support or PC) or, in VC, a much higher decelerating flow with a Ti matched to the effort.

fix.note: Pressure support 12 (ETS 25%): flow now follows the patient's demand and the breath lasts as long as the effort.
